name: CustomerDotsWaffle
job: Make a percentage believable by showing a hundred tiny people; a stream of dots flies in and settles into a grid, with the right share lighting up, such as 92 of 100 customers come back
visitor_action: hover or tap a dot group to see its label; none required
mobile: 10 by 10 grid fits the width, dots settle faster
motion: dots fly in with spring settle, highlighted ones pulse once in a wave (reduced-motion: grid shown settled and lit)
provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Clinic mint: chalky white ground, soft slate dots, one saturated coral highlight, matte ceramic feel with a faint paper grain
notes: Unverified visually (render/craft deferred to QA). The tilted ceramic tray is hand-projected on canvas, so dot hit-testing and the number/tray overlap at mid widths (640-900px) need a look; Figtree is self-hosted from a font file in the folder, which the pasted prompt cannot carry (falls back to system sans). 2026-11-23: targeted fix (Sonnet 5.5, QA near-pass): at >=640px the legend moved from an overlay on the tray corner to its own grid row below the tray stage (labels wrap in pills), so it can never cover dots; tray size and everything else unchanged. Needs QA re-sweep.
